newsitem.title: ITALY: Tosi stock suspended pending announcement.
newsitem.headline: Tosi stock suspended pending announcement.

text.p: Trading on the Milan bourse of shares and warrants in Italian engineering company Franco Tosi, part of the Pesenti group, was suspended ahead of a statement, stock market authority Consob said.

Tosi stock has risen over the last two weeks, jumping to a 14,157 lire average session price on Thursday against 13,785 in the previous session, while its warrant price rose some 18 percent in late Thursday trade.
Dealers said the Tosi rise was linked to the recent surge in Credito Italiano SpA stock. Tosi is a core shareholder of the bank with an official stake of just under four percent.
